reason: The README describes a browser-side IDE-style sidebar focused on switching, filtering, searching, and managing DSH workspaces and sessions, so navigation-panels is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 IDE 风格的工作区与会话侧边栏，用于切换、筛选、搜索及管理工作区和会话。
summaries.en: An IDE-style sidebar for DSH Web that lets users switch, filter, search, and manage workspaces and sessions.

capabilities: Provides a browser-side workspace and session navigation sidebar
Reads workspace and session lists exposed by the DSH client runtime
Creates, renames, archives, and deletes workspaces through DSH client APIs
Renames and deletes sessions through DSH client APIs
